actually_viewed.observation: Detailed Library facade, entrance glazing, columns, upper terrace railing and avatar visible. Preserved generic foreground neighbors obscure portions of the left facade; this is not a full-building view or a claim that neighbors are detailed. Actual catalog source Overture; separate static11 covers forced OSM.

Static catalog re-entry restores the detailed Library entrance and facade, with avatar and retained foreground neighbors. Left facade remains partly occluded by independent coarse neighbors, matching the initial view.

Actual dynamic-only catalog load restores the Library detailed facade, tall glazed entrance and column layout, with retained foreground neighbors and avatar. No obvious missing target facade; left side remains partially occluded by preserved neighbors.
Dynamic catalog return restores the same detailed Library entrance, windows, columns, terrace railings and avatar after unload; preserved coarse foreground neighbors remain in their prior positions.

Deliberately corrupted catalog index rejects the detailed Library. The generic target baseline and independent neighbors remain visible with the avatar. This is expected failure recovery, not an accepted reconstruction image.

scope: Root actually viewed all five images from the completed Library single-browser catalog run. Static adoption/reuse/unload/return, dynamic load/disposal/new-object return, and corrupt-index zero-model-request baseline recovery passed their actual tests. Actual building source is Overture; inactive OSM component-null observations are preserved without claiming active OSM coverage. Separate shared static11 contains the forced-OSM component checks.
limitations: Only the selected Library macro and seven retained neighbors are covered, not every building or ground route.
Generic foreground neighbors obscure part of the Library left facade; these five views do not establish a full unobstructed exterior reconstruction or detailed neighbors.
Model dimensions and unseen details remain estimates; no full interior, collision-free route or hardware FPS claim.
The intentionally rejected-index picture shows the generic baseline, not the accepted detailed model.
